description:
MuscleX Staff is the companion app for gym teams running MuscleX.

Check members in from the floor instead of the front desk. Scan a member's QR code or search by name, and see instantly whether their membership is active, expiring, or overdue.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Check-in — scan a QR code or search, with duplicate scans suppressed automatically
• Members — look up anyone, see their plan, visits, dues and progress
• Money — take a payment, record an expense, see the day's takings
• Schedule — today's classes, who is booked, who turned up
• PT sessions — start, complete and log personal training
• Measurements — trainers can record body stats against a member's profile
• Kiosk mode — turn a spare device into an unattended check-in station

BUILT FOR A GYM FLOOR

The app keeps working when the WiFi does not. Check-ins taken offline are queued and sync as soon as you are back, so a dead spot by the squat racks never stops the queue at the door.

Everyone sees only what their role allows. A trainer sees their clients and classes; the front desk sees check-ins and payments; an owner sees everything. Staff working across more than one location can switch between them without signing out.

REQUIRES A MUSCLEX ACCOUNT

This app is for staff at gyms that use MuscleX. You will need credentials from your gym's administrator to sign in.
promotionalText: Check members in from anywhere on the floor — and keep working when the WiFi drops.
